Experience the majestic Lady Buddha Da Nang statue and Linh Ung Pagoda, perched high above Da Nang. Just a scenic 15-minute scooter ride from My Khe Beach, this spiritual sanctuary offers breathtaking panoramic views of the city, mountains, and South China Sea. See lots of monkeys as well!

🎥 Featuring stunning drone footage showcasing the 67-meter-tall Lady Buddha statue

comments.author: @johnboy5736
comments.text: Hi Jarrat.  WOW !!! Magic !!! video.  I did not know the complex was so big. I'm there     march 25. I will take your advice go late afternoon. Then stop off at the barbi place same as you.   Thank you for sharing your experience.   John

comments.author: @JarrettHolmes
comments.text: Yes, its quite big once you go over to the Pagoda side also. A great 2-3 hour visit if you take your time and see it all. Marble Mountain is much bigger. You can spend all day there seeing all the caves and paths and everything. Glad you enjoyed!

comments.author: @miraclesmolley1
comments.text: I am not sure where did you get your information, but I am 65 years old, was born and raised in Đà Nẵng. My grandma was a Buddhist. If I am not wrong the statute should be "Phật Quan Âm" or "Phật Bà" that probably means Lady Buddha in English .
